title: Agedashi Tofu
description: A classic Japanese dish featuring deep-fried tofu in a light broth, served with grated daikon and tempura bits.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, and 4 cups of water.
Whisk in the cornstarch and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
While the broth is simmering, heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the tofu cubes until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the tofu from the oil and place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain any excess oil.
To serve, place the fried tofu in a bowl and ladle the hot broth over the top.
Garnish with grated daikon and tempura bits.
